own_design_not_observed_reference_behavi: Native AX target is explicit bundle/PID/launch identity and opaque exact window binding.
Central broker owns approvals; trusted asynchronous beforeEffect callback rechecks admission immediately before AX or directed CG input.
Protected and untyped controls are withheld; values/cursor/geometry are checked against the current observation.

security_changes.finding: Cancellation previously resumed the native evaluation continuation before already-dispatched JavaScript finished; a synthetic slow click produced an HTTP effect after the operation had settled.
security_changes.historical_repro_limit: The original assertion was subsequently amended into the fixed-contract regression; the initial log does not claim to identify the current test source at the same line.
security_changes.fix: Cancel and timeout mark evaluations interrupted without resuming or dropping their owner. Only the real WebKit callback or WebContent process-termination notification settles them. Reset and close await the same cleanup. A non-returning script retains pending custody; no external process is killed.

Production automation admits own-PID windows only by native jarvis.browser.* identifier and exact public CGWindowID. Chat, approvals and settings remain excluded. The exact jarvis.automation.fixture identifier additionally requires trusted allowOwnTestWindow, false by default. Window titles do not convey authority; unambiguous AX/CG geometry and native modal/sheet checks are revalidated before effects.
System settings, Keychain, SecurityAgent, authorizationhost and loginwindow bundle targets are rejected at resolve and target validation; no TCC prompting or automatic approval is introduced.

limits: Managed JavaScript evaluation cleanup does not prove all autonomous page activity has ended.
CDP browser identity/network and previously dispatched remote effects remain owned by that existing browser; no transport-close claim verifies their semantics.

own_validation_updates.contract: --automation-test-origin is native-only and absent by default. Parse requires an explicit /private/tmp/ state, canonical http://127.0.0.1:1024...65535 origin, no credentials/path/query/fragment, no recovery or expected-restore bootstrap. Opening a restored profile drops the origin. serviceArguments never forwards it to Python.

restored bootstrap in either flag order
limitations: These are parser/contract tests without filesystem or TCC effects.
An accepted synthetic-state path is not evidence of a sandbox or that the directory contains no owner data.

own_validation_updates.contract: A single shared lifecycle task owns start/stop/reconnect. Duplicate calls join it, in-flight configuration cannot retarget it, and stop wins over pending attach/reconnect while retaining the real registration ACK for exact retirement. The native panel disables configuration/reconnect while lifecycleBusy.
tests: Concurrent signed start calls produce exactly one attach.
Concurrent signed stop calls produce exactly one detach and share its confirmed result.
Concurrent reconnect calls perform exactly one retirement and replacement registration.
Stop during delayed attach drains and retires that acknowledged host before allowing a new start.
Stop during delayed reconnect prevents replacement registration.
own_validation_updates.scope: Real actor scheduling and signed IPC with own delayed local handlers. The two integration cases also exercise private WebKit, model/approval fixtures and an independent synthetic HTTP/file oracle.
limits: No real ChatGPT inference, owner data, AX input, TCC grant or external browser qualification.
This selection is separate from the 39-test component selection and is not a full-suite total.

own_validation_updates.finding: A real own synthetic AppKit window passed resolve/windows/observe, but an approved fresh set_value was rejected before dispatch. Two subsequent read-only observations showed a new empty AXGroup child under a pre-existing empty chrome AXGroup; all substantive fields and bounds matched.
own_validation_updates.fix: The semantic CAS digest recursively prunes only wholly empty AXGroup subtrees: enabled true, no label, no value, no actions, nonsecure, no selection and no truncation. The fixed point is bounded to 160 nodes; cycles/missing parents/duplicate IDs keep the original tree. Visible nodes, operation refs, IDs of all retained controls and physical AX bindings are unchanged.

cycle or missing parent or duplicate IDs

own_validation_updates.finding: The live independent AppKit target incremented its counter exactly once to CONTADOR 1, but the original receipt remained unknown/native_action_unconfirmed. The AX press/scroll branch returned before using an explicit verify_ref/expected_value; only the CG input branch previously consumed those fields.
own_validation_updates.fix: AX press/scroll dispatch exactly once, then perform bounded exact AX readback if explicitly requested, for either acknowledged or missing native ACK. Each read rechecks central lease, target identity, exact physical window and a known nonsecure role on the original verification element. A match verifies only that exact postcondition state; metadata native_acknowledged keeps ACK evidence separate. Nonmatch/error/cancel/revocation stays unknown, without resend.
